name: Ryoujoku no Mori ~Oyako Kankin Camp~
original_name: 凌辱の杜 ～母娘監禁キャンプ～
source:
During summer vacation a quiet family gathering at campsite become a scene of tragic crime after a visit of a heinous bank robbers. Thugs take protagonist hostage and violate his mother and sister in his presence.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假里，一场原本安静的家庭露营活动，因穷凶极恶的银行劫匪闯入而化为悲剧犯罪现场。恶徒将主人公扣为人质，当着他的面侵犯母亲和妹妹。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
